description: Answers a replacement offer for a Press Room item that could not be published. accept orders the proposed equivalent now and reserves its price (never more than the first item's) from the existing balance; refund takes the credits back to the balance, where they already are (no card is refunded). Use this when the person has chosen between the replacement and the credits back. Do not use for an order that was published. Side effects: accept reserves credits and starts publication; refund changes nothing else.

choice.description: accept (order the proposed replacement now) or refund (the value kept for older clients: credits back to the balance, no card refund). Example: "accept"

offer_id.description: The replacement offer id from get_order_status. Example: "5f0c2a9e-7b1d-4c3e-9a8f-2d6b4e1c7a90"

name: respond_to_replacement
title: Respond to a replacement offer
